       BE I T ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. That, Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago {''Chicago Zoning

Ordinance") be amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in the area bounded

by

       the alley next north of and parallel to West Newport Avenue; a line 37.50
       feet east of and parallel to North Ravenswood Avenue; West Newport
       Avenue; and North Ravenswood Avenue,


to those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.


       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.

9.    Present Zoning District: RS-3                   Proposed Zoning District: RT-4

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 37.5 feet x 125.1 feet = 4.691.25 square feet (recorded)

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subject property consists of a single lot of record. The site is
      currently improved with a one-storv (with basement) single-family residence and a detached
      garage, which such accessory structure is accessed directly off of Ravenswood Avenue.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is seeking a Zoning Map Amendment in order to
      permit the construction ofa new three-story three-unit residential building, with off-street (garage)
      parking for three (3) vehicles, at the subject site.

13.   Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling unit
      number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and height of
      the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC) The subiect property consists of a single lot of record,
      which comprises the northeast corner of Newport Avenue and Ravenswood Avenue. The site is
      currently improved with a one-story (with basement) single-family residence and a detached
      garage. The Applicant is seeking a Zoning Map Amendment in order to permit the construction of
      a new three-story (with basement) multi-unit residential building, with off-street vehicular parking
      for each unit, at the subiect site. In order to allow for the proposed new improvements, the existing
      structures will be razed. The proposed new building will feature a total of three (3) dwelling units,
      located on and between the Basement thru 3^^* Floors. The programming for the proposed
      development also calls for the provision of parking for three (3) vehicles within a one-story
      detached garage, at the rear of the site, which such garage will be accessed via the Public Alley.
      The proposed new building will measure 36 feet-4 inches in height and will be masonry in
      construction.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or a
      financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
      Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?

      YES             NO      X
